kicker: AA-3D, refitted from its own leaderboard

scenes.headline: How blind votes on 3D scenes become a ranking
scenes.sub: Agents build three.js pages; people pick between pairs.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Pollux! A new benchmark ranks models by how well they build interactive 3D scenes. Here is how votes become a ranking.

scenes.text: Every model gets the same brief, sandbox and clock; people vote on blind pairs, and one fit turns all the votes into a rating per model.
scenes.mark: one fit turns all the votes into a rating
scenes.say: Same brief, same sandbox, same clock. People vote on blind pairs, and one fit turns every vote into a rating.

steps.say: A brief goes to a model working as an agent in an offline sandbox, for up to three hours.
It returns one web page. A browser checks that it loads and keeps rendering. A scene that fails never reaches a voter.
A panelist explores two scenes from the same brief, thirty seconds each, without knowing who built them, and picks one.
One fit turns all the votes into a strength per model, pinned so one model sits at a thousand.

parts.note: only the gap between two ratings matters
parts.say: Only the gap between two ratings matters.
Four hundred points is ten to one odds.

left.title: Bars overlap
items: Each bar is a gap to the anchor
left.say: The launch calls four models tied because their bars overlap. But every bar is a gap to the same anchor.

right.title: Interval of the gap
right.say: The right test is the interval of the gap itself: about thirty-seven points.

scenes.title: The top four, AA-3D Elo
scenes.say: Sonnet to Fable is sixty-three points. So three models are tied at the top, and Fable is fourth, as the leaderboard's own rank range says.

steps.say: The model holds up. Each dot is a pair of models; the curve is what the rating gap predicts.
Sonnet against Luna: the fit expects three in four, and the panel gave exactly that.

scenes.text: A preference rating tells you what people like after thirty seconds, given a scene that works. Test gaps, not overlapping bars.
scenes.say: Read it as what people prefer after half a minute, given a scene that works. And test gaps, not overlapping bars.

recap: One fit turns votes into ratings
Test the gap, not the overlap
scenes.say: Same brief, one fit, and test the gap. Thanks for watching!
